prompt:
Faithful smooth HD remaster of 2 EXACT animation poses from Sam & Max Hit the Road (1993). Output 1536 x 1024 PNG RGBA, fully transparent background. Image 1 is the complete source sprite atlas: trace each original shape at the same size, position, proportions and pose, including all small pieces. Gray padding becomes transparent. One original pixel equals four output pixels in image 1. Every complete sprite belongs entirely in its own 768 x 1024 cell. Do not enlarge to fill empty space, move limbs, add a pose or cross a cell edge. Image 4 is a larger source DETAIL of these SAME poses, not an extra pose to draw. Use it to resolve hands, mouth and folded ears; image 1 still controls size and position.

Image 2 is approved Sam design and clean line style; image 3 approved Max. Geometry and exact pose come ONLY from image 1/4. BOTH characters are present together. Sam is the large brown long-muzzled dog in blue-gray suit and fedora, white shirt and dark striped tie where visible. Max is cream with tiny black eyes, pink nose, original pointed-tooth grin/open mouth, long ears visible ONLY as the source shows. In this animation Sam holds Max by the FOLDED EARS and swings him, then throws him upward on BEIGE TWINE tied to a dinosaur tooth. Beige material is twine, not new fur/clothing. The brown patch atop Max head is Sam gripping HAND, not brown hair, a cap, crown or new accessory. Preserve deliberate squash/stretch and occluded parts exactly; never complete hidden ears, hands, faces or a missing/hidden head. Match the original visible finger count and contact points.

Each sprite includes the long extremely thin vertical beige twine ending in a tiny Y fork, the loose beige twine coil at lower left, all thin trailing string curves, and a tiny isolated blue paint mark. Preserve source-confirmed small loose cream marks too. Ordinary matte string, NOT a glowing pole. Same flat source local colors with only original shade, clean tapering dark cartoon contours; no glossy highlights, gradients, glow, halo, haze, texture, cast shadows, floor, checkerboard, text, labels, borders or invented loops/details. Transparent gaps stay transparent. Sam facing away has NO front face or tie painted onto the back of the suit. Keep all heads, bodies and props together at source anchors. This corrects the generic source job description which names Sam alone; the protected original files remain unchanged.
Cell 1: original full box begins [150, 216], exact size [468, 592]. Sam turns to show his back/left side, looking left toward Max held in front of his face. Max faces the viewer with knees/feet raised toward viewer, original visible grin, ears compressed under the grip. Twine has a broad curve at right behind Sam and low across the ground.
Cell 2: original full box begins [928, 214], exact size [448, 596]. Sam faces fully AWAY: back of hat, back of brown head/ears and suit visible, NO eyes/muzzle/tie on his back. Max faces viewer at Sam left, feet lifted forward toward viewer. Sam left hand grips the top of Max head and folded ears. Right arm lowered outward. String loops low around the feet as shown.
